description: Burkina Faso - Electricity Transmission Network is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Christopher Arderne (World Bank Group). This majority of this data is based on a digitized PDF map, and so is intended as a schematic of rough locations of the power network. It is not suitable for applications requiring high accuracy. Additional updated data for 2017 from ECREEE transmission network for West Africa, online at ECOWREX. Coverage: Burkina Faso. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, SHP ZIP. The portal files it under Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
